name: @elizaos/os
description: elizaOS operating-system distributions, installers, and release infrastructure.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd setup build && bun run --cwd usb-installer build && bun run build:browser
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p linux/installer/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p setup/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p setup/tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p usb-installer/tsconfig.json && bun run typecheck:browser
scripts.format: bunx @biomejs/biome format --write trust contracts linux/installer && bun run --cwd setup format && bun run --cwd usb-installer format
scripts.test: bun run test:trust && bun run --cwd linux/installer test && bun run --cwd setup test && bun run --cwd usb-installer test && bun run test:browser
scripts.verify: bun run verify:installer-native && bun run verify:portable && bun run test:release && bun run test:ota-publisher
scripts.verify:linux: bash scripts/linux/mkosi-lint.sh && python3 scripts/linux/test_disposable_disk_vm.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_mkosi_qualification.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_verify_desktop_artifact.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_stage_browser_artifact.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_assemble_browser_payload.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_mkosi_reproducibility.py && python3 scripts/linux/test_riscv64_agent_staging.py
scripts.test:ota-trust: node --test native/ota-trust/scripts/*.test.mjs && cd native/ota-trust && go test -race ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.lint:check: bunx @biomejs/biome check trust contracts && bun run --cwd linux/installer lint:check && bun run --cwd setup lint:check && bun run --cwd usb-installer lint:check && bun run lint:browser
scripts.verify:portable: bun run typecheck && bun run lint:check && bun run test
